Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a high fidelity desktop website screenshot for Matt Zhang's Resources page. Reference image supplies the approved sidebar and title/author structure, but RESTYLE toward the actual original academic website: pure white, classic Times-like serif body 19.5 CSS px, black text, original blue #0066cc regular-weight resource titles 19.5px, muted gray authors 16px on their own SECOND line, restrained serif category headings 23px, small Resources page heading 32px. NO huge bold sans typography. Render approximately 1440x1050 desktop viewport, actual content centered with total width about 960 CSS pixels, generous outside white margins; main resource reading column about 680px, sidebar about 190px, gap 40px, fine pale vertical divider. Page heading 'Resources', small gray intro 'A collection of useful reading.' Main section 'Undergrad/College Study'. Sample annotation control only exists on first resource and exam study guide, not all resources. It is subdued gray 14px serif under author, not prominent blue button.
